subject: Invoice author & delivery path for Orchid AI — who will emit invoices and VAT evidence
messages:
From: Elena Park <elena.park@orchidai.com>
To: Kimberly Park <kimberly_park@redwood.ai>, Marissa Cole <marissa_cole@redwood.ai>
Cc: Connor O'Brien <connor_obrien@redwood.ai>
Date: 2026-12-01T14:12:00+00:00
Subject: Who sends our invoices? AP delivery + VAT evidence

Hi Kimberly / Marissa,

We are getting ready to go live and AP asked one quick thing: who will be the sender of the invoices for the DF-9321 subscription? Our default preference is to receive PDF invoices at ap@orchidai.com, and we will need explicit EU VAT proof (VAT certificate or signed statement) attached to the first invoice.

Options we'd accept: (A) Redwood emits invoices directly to ap@orchidai.com (PDF) with VAT cert attached; (B) Redwood puts invoices into the billing portal and we pull them (we will create a portal account); or (C) a hybrid: first invoice emailed, subsequent invoices via portal.

Could you confirm which approach is easiest operationally and whether Redwood can add our PO number (PO-7782) and Company ID in the invoice subject line?

Thanks,
Elena Park
Finance Ops | Orchid AI

Attachment: VAT_Certificate_ORCHID.pdf (application/pdf)
From: Kimberly Park <kimberly_park@redwood.ai>
To: Elena Park <elena.park@orchidai.com>
Cc: Marissa Cole <marissa_cole@redwood.ai>, Connor O'Brien <connor_obrien@redwood.ai>
Date: 2026-12-01T16:05:00+00:00
Subject: Re: Who sends our invoices? AP delivery + VAT evidence

Hi Elena — thanks for the clear options. Short answer: we can support any of the three; recommend (C) for a smooth go-live (email + VAT cert for the first invoice, then portal-only thereafter). A couple of operational notes: 

- Emission: We normally emit invoices from billing@redwood.ai. If you want the first invoice emailed, we can send a signed PDF to ap@orchidai.com.
- Portal: If you choose portal-only after the first invoice, we'll need the email for the portal admin (who will be invited).
- PO & subject line: we can include PO-7782 and "OrchidAI-DF9321" in the subject — confirm the exact label you want.
- VAT evidence: we will attach the VAT certificate to the first invoice. If you require a separate signed VAT declaration, let us know.

I'll loop in Marissa to confirm the invoice sender address and the sample invoice format.

Best,
Kimberly Park
Billing Operations Manager | Redwood Inference

--

Kimberly / Elena — quick process note and sample attached.

Process we propose:
1) First invoice (proforma + VAT evidence) emailed from billing@redwood.ai to ap@orchidai.com. We'll attach VAT_Certificate_ORCHID.pdf and a signed PDF.
2) Concurrently we invite Orchid's portal admin to Redwood Console so future invoices are downloadable (monthly consolidated statement available).
3) Invoice subject line will read: "Redwood Invoice DF-9321 | Orchid AI | PO-7782"
4) We can enable monthly consolidation (single line per invoice) if you prefer one consolidated monthly PDF instead of individual charges; please confirm.

Attached is a Sample_Invoice-DF9321.pdf showing the remit address and EU VAT presentation we use. If that layout is OK, we will lock it for recurring emission.

Connor — please confirm the sender domain and whether we need any special header for AP systems (X-Remit-ID).

Thanks,
Marissa
Sr. Billing Ops | Redwood Inference

Attachment: Sample_Invoice-DF9321.pdf (application/pdf)
